correctness.rationale: The proof covers all finite word lengths. Two mismatches between rotations must exchange one symbol pair by Parikh preservation. A different pair would make a nonzero cyclic translation preserve a signed indicator difference with precisely one positive coordinate, which is impossible. The exhibited triple has two distinct pair types unaffected by any simultaneous insertion. All finite corroboration outputs were produced by verify.py.
